page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head "AD INDOS." at the top, page number 173 at the top right, catchword "sint" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: plicabitur scientia: tunc intelligentes ful-gebunt ut splendor firmamenti, justifican-tes multos, tanquam stellae in seculum & in aeternum. Lumine enim Evangelij ami-cti, tenebras in Satanae regno dominan-tes discutient, multos ad justitiam fidei adducentes: servisque Dei, manum in propagando regno Christi, maxima auxi-lij divini illorum opus comitante efficacia praebebunt.

Erit namque, illustris plane & admirabilis illorum conversio, novum in terris creans gaudium, & rerum omnium innovationem, quatenus Antichristi patietur violentia, secum adducens: si enimQuibus signâ maxima fa-voris sui Do-minus ostin-det. nemini contemptibilis & vilis fuerit, diesZach. 4.10. ille parvarum consolationum, quum pri-mitiae Iudæorum, colligerentur ab Apo-stolis, quanto magis firmabitur, quanto-que speciosius erit, opus templi divini; quum Israelem lapidem stannum, Zerubabel noster spiritualis, Dominus Iesus, in manu sumpserit, ut eo veram Ecclesiam suam, quæ templum Dei est, ædificet. Dabit enim opus eorum in veritate,& fœ-dus sempiternum feriet cum eis: notum erit in gentibus semen eorum, & germina eorum in medio populorum: omnesEsaj. 61. qui viderint eos, cognoscent eos, quod

page.notes: Marginal notes printed in the right margin: "Quibus signâ maxima favoris sui Dominus ostendet." (the third word of the last line, "oftin-", is hard to read and I transcribed it as "ostin-det" with some doubt), "Zach. 4.10.", "Esaj. 61." The catchword "sint" is printed at the bottom right, below the last line. The word "Iesus" is set in small capitals in the print. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed.
